verdict.rationale: The evidence documents async jobs, webhook completion and cancel callbacks, and job read endpoints. None of it shows a field for attaching custom identifiers or metadata to a job, or that such values are echoed back in results or webhook payloads. The custom user-agent option is an unrelated fetch setting and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach my own identifiers or metadata to a job and get them back in results and webhook payloads
